Questions people ask

Do I need an account?

No. You can draw routes, explore and run without one. With an account you can save your runs, keep favorite routes and publish your drawings.

Why doesn't the route look exactly like my shape?

Streets rarely follow a shape exactly, so MuW looks for the streets that draw it best and offers up to three routes. If another distance draws better, the app says so with «Try 12 km»; you can also start from a different place.

How do I delete my account?

In «Settings», tap «Delete account». Everything that is yours is deleted at once.
